deviations: Port only picker search, grouping and focus; retain existing Gi composer integrations.
Group full ancestry before filtering, preserving current-tree identity when the current session is filtered out.
Restore the exact pointer/keyboard trigger on Escape; blank-compose @ returns to the session pill.
Preserve native Tab and text Home/End; Enter on a focused action activates that action rather than the highlighted search index.
Rebind capture keyboard handler in layout effect; functional index updates prevent stale rapid-key navigation.
Keep existing menu/menuitem roles and add labelled search/group elements; do not claim upstream listbox semantics.
Gi-local responsive search/action CSS in internal/web/static/css/chat.css.
Gi host callbacks persist pin/rename/archive/restore through PATCH /api/sessions/{id}; pinning is database-backed, not upstream browser-local preferences.
Row capability controls, inline name form and archive confirmation retain selection/drafts on failure. No permanent delete is supplied.
Native state determines activity; picker feedback uses open/mount epochs to suppress late results after dismissal.
Mention autocomplete uses native agent_id, not mutable session display names; browser acceptance protects routing after rename.
Gi draft callbacks journal captured sends in browser-local IndexedDB before network I/O; host-owned recovery merges newer text/media/refs across unmount/revisit.
Upload receives captured chat JID; native prompt carries media references; preserve 10 MiB cap and show actual submission/storage errors.
Acknowledged sends never restore on later UI refresh failure; deferred picker Escape focus does not steal focus from newly focused composer.

QueuedFollowupStack uses durable row IDs, disables overlapping mutations and omits Steer without a callback; Gi host supplies optimistic reorder/remove with authoritative refresh and origin/revision guards.
Queued composer submissions expose origin-owned optimistic lifecycle callbacks and carry client_request_id correlation metadata; pending queue controls remain disabled until durable.

Gi extends the chat-keyed hook with a selection-generation key and active-effect guard so replaced transports cannot call current handlers before/after cleanup. Native transport moved to gi-sse-client.ts with source-instance guards.
